evidence.quote: the company grew revenue 85% year over year, while diluted earnings per share soared by 140%
evidence.one_line: Nvidia reported Q1 FY2027 (ended 2026-04-26) revenue up 85% year over year and diluted EPS up 140%.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia (as reported by Motley Fool)

evidence.quote: Jensen Huang said he expects the company's Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips to generate $1 trillion in sales between that time and the end of 2027
evidence.one_line: CEO Jensen Huang said in March 2026 he expects Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips to generate $1 trillion in sales from March 2026 through end-2027.
evidence.speaker: Jensen Huang (as reported by Motley Fool)

evidence.quote: Management said they think they can generate nearly $20 billion of CPU sales
evidence.one_line: Nvidia management said it thinks it can generate nearly $20 billion of CPU sales, after announcing plans to expand into CPUs in Q1 FY2027.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia management (as reported by Motley Fool)

evidence.quote: Wall Street consensus estimates suggest the company will earn adjusted earnings per share of $8.97 in its current fiscal year.
evidence.one_line: Wall Street consensus estimates adjusted EPS of $8.97 for Nvidia's current fiscal year (FY2027).
evidence.speaker: Motley Fool author citing Wall Street consensus
